objective: Establish a deterministic reference disaster-recovery orchestration contract that consumes canonical P22-E backup manifests and P22-F restore-drill results, requires safe operational state and explicit owner recovery authorization, and produces a content-addressed recovery plan without executing failover, network, storage, DNS, state mutation or trading actions.
scope: Bind disaster-recovery plans to canonical P22-E BackupManifest and P22-F RestoreDrillResult
Allow recovery planning only from HALTED or EMERGENCY system states
Require a PASS and trusted P22-F drill for the same backup manifest
Require integrity/quarantine/reconciliation validation inherited from P22-F
Require recovery target failure-domain separation for DR0/DR1/DR2
Require explicit owner recovery authorization before a plan can become REFERENCE_RECOVERY_READY
Produce deterministic ordered reference recovery steps
out_of_scope: DNS, routing, load-balancer or network mutation
tests: Only HALTED/EMERGENCY states are eligible for disaster-recovery planning
Non-PASS or untrusted restore drill fails closed
DR0/DR1/DR2 same failure-domain target fails closed
Owner recovery authorization is required for REFERENCE_RECOVERY_READY
All plans retain execution_authority=false and production_mutation=false
P22-G evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P22-G disaster-recovery policy/module/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P22-A..P22-F remain canonical complete and P22-H remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
